items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Ford built Roberts' as a comparison to Chicago's black music scene; Interviewee agrees 'Yeah, that’s true.'

ctx.x: No, but I didn’t think that came into existence —

No, we get hand me down... do you think that the Braddock in New York — no, we’d never have — the black man didn’t build no — if they did, they did it in Chicago like Ford built Roberts. But the rest of what we had was hand-me-downs, you know like the white folks moved out —
